name: Mu (Another World)
source:
An ancient hero who was the administrator of a dying world.

In order to destroy the Creator God, she offered the potential of the world itself to Mu from another world. As a result, she brought about the destruction of her world along with the destruction of the Creator God.

It is said that Mu from the current world added her own power and created a tool to defeat the Creator God.

The chain around her neck was attached to the Creator God Naia, and it remains even now that Naia has been destroyed.
